verdict.rationale: Goodwin's VC practice page states it represents 1,200+ emerging companies and 200+ VC/PE firms with 180 lawyers covering 'early and growth stage venture deals,' which gestures at scale and seed-through-growth coverage, but there are no stated deal volume figures (e.g., dollars raised, number of financings closed per year) or representative/named transactions to substantiate priced equity round experience across the full seed-to-late-stage spectrum. Missing for 10: quantified deal volume statistics, representative transaction examples or case studies, and explicit confirmation of late-stage/pre-IPO equity round work.
